name: Cloak of Elvenkind

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: With the hood up: Advantage on Stealth checks, and Perception checks to see you have Disadvantage.
text: With the hood raised, your Dexterity (Stealth) checks have Advantage, and anyone trying to spot you with a Wisdom (Perception) check rolls with Disadvantage. Raising or lowering the hood takes no action.
